createOrReplace.title: Admission Requirements | Canadian University Dubai
createOrReplace.excerpt: General eligibility: UAE secondary education certificate with passing grade in all subjects; non-UAE certificates processed under UAE Ministry rules (British System: Completion of Year 13 / Grade 12; Equivalency Certificate issued by Ministry of Education in the UAE). English: IELTS Academic 5.0, TOEFL iBT 61 unless exempt (UAE Advanced Track 80% in English; English-medium curricula with official proof). Math placement exemption: UAE High School Math 70% or SAT Math 450. Engineering: UAE System (Advanced Track) Mathematics, Physics, Science (Biology or Chemistry) minimum 80%; American System Grades 9-12, diploma, Maths/Physics/Science 80%; British System Year 13, minimum of 7 subjects with C in five O-Levels and D in 2 AS or 1 A Level, Maths and Physics C at O Level / C at AS / D at A Level, Science C at O Level or D at AS/A Level; IB minimum 24 points, IB Diploma with 6 subjects (excluding Islamic Education), Mathematics, Physics, Science minimum 5.

set.academic_threshold: British system: completion of Year 13 / Grade 12, with a UAE Ministry of Education equivalency certificate. CUD gives no minimum grade for this programme. English: no test needed if your school taught in English (official proof) or, on the UAE Advanced Track, with 80% in English; otherwise IELTS Academic 5.0 / TOEFL iBT 61. All admitted students take a Maths placement test unless they have 70% in UAE high-school Maths or SAT Math 450.
